findings.evidence: Basic.lean:299-302; `def fourierCoeff ... := ∫ t, fourier (-n) t • f t ∂haarAddCircle` and `theorem fourierCoeff_fourier ... = Pi.single n 1` at upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Fourier/AddCircle.lean:298 and :514.
findings.fix: Insert the intermediate step explicitly, e.g. `have : anisotropyCoeff (haarAddCircle (T := T)) n = fourierCoeff (fourier n) 0 := by simp only [anisotropyCoeff_def, fourierCoeff, neg_zero, fourier_zero, one_smul]` and then `rw [this, fourierCoeff_fourier, Pi.single_apply]` plus an explicit `if`-condition flip, rather than one default `simpa` with `eq_comm`.
findings.issue: `anisotropyCoeff_haarAddCircle` is closed by `simpa [anisotropyCoeff_def, fourierCoeff, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm] using congrFun (fourierCoeff_fourier (T := T) n) 0` — a terse `simpa` over the full default simp set that must unfold the `fourierCoeff` *definition* (`∫ t, fourier (-n) t • f t ∂haarAddCircle`, Mathlib/Analysis/Fourier/AddCircle.lean:298), silently simplify `fourier (-0) t • fourier n t` to `fourier n t`, and flip `Pi.single n 1 0` with the permutative `eq_comm`. None of that is visible, and it breaks on any change to the `fourier_zero'`/`Pi.single` simp normal forms.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:288-294; `fourierCoeff` is a plain `def` with no API lemma for the unfolded integral, so both proofs re-derive it via simp.
findings.fix: Replace with a `simp only` naming the rewrites (`anisotropyCoeff_def`, `integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul₀ hf hf_lt_top`, `Complex.real_smul`) followed by `rw [fourierCoeff, neg_neg]` and a pointwise `mul_comm _ _` under `integral_congr`, and reuse that unfolding lemma in `anisotropyCoeff_haarAddCircle`.
findings.issue: Same pattern in `anisotropyCoeff_withDensity_eq_fourierCoeff_neg`: a single default `simp` that unfolds `fourierCoeff` and adds `mul_comm` to the simp set, so the reconciliation of `fourier (-(-n))` with `fourier n` and of `•` with `*` is invisible. This is the second place that unfolds `fourierCoeff` by hand; the shared step (`anisotropyCoeff μ n` as a `fourierCoeff` at index `-n`) is never isolated.

findings.fix: Pin the arguments — `rw [mul_comm (fourier n ψ) (qVector n φ)]` at line 108 (or drop it and use `Finset.mul_sum`), and `mul_comm (fourier n x) (fourier n ψ)` at line 311.
findings.issue: Argument-free `rw [mul_comm]` in `qVector_add_const` (line 108) and again in `anisotropyCoeff_map_add_const` (line 311): the rewrite lands on whichever product the traversal meets first, so a later change to either statement redirects it silently instead of failing loudly.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust automation or single explicit simp only/rw steps, but the two `fourierCoeff` lemmas are closed by default `simp`/`simpa` that unfold the `fourierCoeff` definition with permutative lemmas added, hiding the step that makes them work and duplicating it; two argument-free `rw [mul_comm]` steps are needlessly position-dependent.
